description: This file defines a Java interface for initializing or populating a database, including methods to check if the database is empty and to populate it with a given name.

classes.name: InitializationDatabase
classes.description: Java interface representing database initialization operations, such as checking if the database is empty and populating it.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the database referenced by the implementation is empty.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the database with data associated with the specified name, may throw a ServiceException.
